knowledge:
- key_parameters: genes=A list containing a background vector of genes and one or more test set vectors of genes ;; pathways=A list of pathway annotations (e.g., loaded from a GMT file) ;; chartData=Specifies the data type to plot on nodes in EnrichmentMap (e.g., "DATA_SET" or "NES_VALUE") ;; qvalue=FDR threshold for filtering significant pathways (e.g., 0.05)
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: When you have one or more sets of genes (e.g., from CRISPR screens, differential expression, or genetic interactions) and a background gene list, and you want to test them for both pathway enrichment and depletion using a Fisher's exact test with custom or standard pathway annotations.
- pitfalls: High overlap across test gene sets can lead to similar enrichment results across tests (the package throws a warning: "X% of genes overlap across your test gene sets"). Cytoscape and the EnrichmentMap (>= v3.3.0) and AutoAnnotate apps must be open and running on the computer before calling plotFemap().

workflows.name: pathway_enrichment_and_depletion_analysis
workflows.intent: Test one or more gene sets against a background for pathway enrichment and depletion using Fisher's exact test, visualize with a dot plot, and generate an enrichment map in Cytoscape.
input: gene_list.rds (A named list containing a 'background' character vector and one or more test set character vectors)
workflows.stages: 1. Run the enrichment/depletion analysis using runFedup ;; 2. Format and filter results using dplyr and tidyr ;; 3. Plot significant results using plotDotPlot ;; 4. Write out formatted results for EnrichmentMap using writeFemap ;; 5. Write out pathway annotations to GMT format using writePathways ;; 6. Generate and visualize the enrichment map in Cytoscape using plotFemap
workflows.code:
fedupRes <- runFedup(geneDouble, pathwaysGMT)

fedupPlot <- fedupRes %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "set") %>%
    separate(col = "set", into = c("set", "sign"), sep = "_") %>%
    subset(qvalue < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(log10qvalue = -log10(qvalue)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("\\%.*", "", pathway)) %>%
    as.data.frame()

p <- plotDotPlot(
        df = fedupPlot,
        xVar = "log10qvalue",
        yVar = "pathway",
        xLab = "-log10(qvalue)",
        fillVar = "sign",
        fillLab = "Genetic interaction",
        fillCol = c("#6D90CA", "#F6EB13"),
        sizeVar = "fold_enrichment",
        sizeLab = "Fold enrichment") +
    facet_grid("sign", scales = "free", space = "free") +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_blank())
print(p)

resultsFolder <- tempdir()
writeFemap(fedupRes, resultsFolder)

gmtFile <- tempfile("pathwaysGMT", fileext = ".gmt")
writePathways(pathwaysGMT, gmtFile)

netFile <- tempfile("fedupEM_geneDouble", fileext = ".png")
plotFemap(
    gmtFile = gmtFile,
    resultsFolder = resultsFolder,
    qvalue = 0.05,
    chartData = "DATA_SET",
    hideNodeLabels = TRUE,
    netName = "fedupEM_geneDouble",
    netFile = netFile
)
